description: Model weights used by services/vision. Fetch with scripts/fetch_models.py; the weights themselves are gitignored. Every URL is pinned to a commit or release asset and verified against sha256 before use.

models.name: face_detection_yunet
models.description: YuNet face detector with dynamic input shape, the OpenCV 5.x default. Returns boxes, 5 landmarks and a score per face (cv2.FaceDetectorYN).
models.notes: License verified 2026-10-20 by reading models/face_detection_yunet/LICENSE at the pinned commit: MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Shiqi Yu. sha256 equals the Git LFS oid at that commit.

models.name: face_recognition_sface
models.upstream: https://github.com/zhongyy/SFace (no LICENSE file upstream; the model was contributed to opencv_zoo by its author)
models.description: SFace face-recognition embeddings (MobileFaceNet, 128-d) for selfie/ID comparison (cv2.FaceRecognizerSF).
models.notes: License verified 2026-10-20 by reading models/face_recognition_sface/LICENSE at the pinned commit (Apache License 2.0 full text); the directory README states all files are Apache 2.0. sha256 equals the Git LFS oid at that commit.

models.name: anti_spoof_minifasnet_v2
models.description: Passive anti-spoofing classifier MiniFASNetV2 (input 1x3x80x80, crop scale 2.7, 3-class output). Used by the Phase 4 liveness ensemble.
models.notes: License verified 2026-10-20: hosting repo LICENSE and upstream LICENSE are both the Apache License 2.0 text. sha256 matches the digest GitHub publishes for the release asset; release assets are mutable, so any change fails the pin loudly.

models.name: anti_spoof_minifasnet_v1se
models.description: Passive anti-spoofing classifier MiniFASNetV1SE (input 1x3x80x80, crop scale 4.0, 3-class output). Used by the Phase 4 liveness ensemble.
models.notes: License verified 2026-10-20: hosting repo LICENSE and upstream LICENSE are both the Apache License 2.0 text. sha256 matches the digest GitHub publishes for the release asset; release assets are mutable, so any change fails the pin loudly.

models.name: text_detection_ppocrv6_small
models.upstream: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR (Apache-2.0; LICENSE at tag v3.7.0, commit b03f46425e8ff4442b268ce449e3eef758146cd4)
models.description: PP-OCRv6 small text-line detector (DB, input 1x3xHxW, one probability map out). Visual-zone text of the rectified government ID (C32.1 text); post-processed by the RapidOCR-derived code in services/vision/src/openverify_vision/ocr/.
models.notes: License verified 2026-10-21: the model card at the pinned commit declares license: apache-2.0 (cardData), author PaddlePaddle; the repository has no LICENSE file of its own, and PaddleOCR's LICENSE is the Apache License 2.0 text. sha256 computed from the downloaded file and equal to the Git LFS oid at the commit.

models.name: text_recognition_ppocrv6_small
models.upstream: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR (Apache-2.0; LICENSE at tag v3.7.0, commit b03f46425e8ff4442b268ce449e3eef758146cd4)
models.description: PP-OCRv6 small text-line recognizer (input Nx3x48xW, CTC over 18,710 classes: blank, the 18,708 characters of text_recognition_ppocrv6_small_dict, space). Visual-zone text and MRZ lines (C32.1 text, mrz).
models.notes: License verified 2026-10-21: the model card at the pinned commit declares license: apache-2.0 (cardData), author PaddlePaddle; the repository has no LICENSE file of its own, and PaddleOCR's LICENSE is the Apache License 2.0 text. sha256 computed from the downloaded file and equal to the Git LFS oid at the commit.

models.name: text_recognition_ppocrv6_small_dict
models.upstream: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR (Apache-2.0; LICENSE at tag v3.7.0, commit b03f46425e8ff4442b268ce449e3eef758146cd4)
models.description: The recognizer's inference configuration. Its PostProcess.character_dict (CTCLabelDecode) is the character dictionary, 18,708 single characters, read by openverify_vision.ocr.dictionary; nothing else in the file is used.
models.notes: Same repository, commit and license as text_recognition_ppocrv6_small. Not weights, but a downloaded artefact all the same: fetched, never committed. sha256 computed from the downloaded file.

models.name: canonical_face_mesh
models.upstream: MediaPipe face geometry module (mediapipe/modules/face_geometry/data, BUILD licenses(["notice"]))
models.description: MediaPipe's canonical 3-D face mesh: 468 vertices, 468 UVs, 898 triangles, in centimetres (Y up, Z toward the viewer). Its points anchor the server head pose (SQPnP, C41.1) and the 2.5-D re-posed head-turn fixtures (C45.2). Not weights: a small geometry file, fetched like one.
models.notes: License verified 2026-10-21 (docs/research/phase4-models.md §2 and §10.4): the repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0 and the data directory's BUILD declares licenses(["notice"]). The file is identical at a908d66 (its last change, 2020-09-17) and at master 0e152b3. Attribution in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
